exit.note: beyond f_max, the exit depends on borrowers repaying / on rates rising

decision.sentence: Curator view (whole vault, all depositors): EXIT means pulling the vault's money out of its markets, STAY means keeping the allocation. STAY — exiting (only 1% can be exited now) would avoid $0 of expected loss over the horizon, but would cost $0. Exit if you put the risk "ETH+ collateral drop" above 4.4% (our estimate: 0.10%, i.e. ≈ once every 20 years).

incidents.title: ETH+ collateral drop
incidents.rule: sudden shock on a collateral whose oracle does NOT follow the market (internal rate / set price): no timely liquidation → bad debt max(0, D − V·(1−d)·(1−slippage)), borrower by borrower
